transcript.content: Hi, this is Sophia Taylor. I have reservation PEP4E0. I need to cancel my flight right away—there's been a family emergency. I'm extremely upset and this is urgent. I need a full refund because of the circumstances.
I'm sorry to hear about your family emergency. Let me pull up your reservation right away.

I've located your reservation. Here are the details:

- **Reservation:** PEP4E0
- **Route:** CLT → DTW → PHX (one-way)
- **Flights:** HAT176 & HAT097 on May 20, 2024
- **Cabin:** Basic Economy
- **Passengers:** Sophia Taylor
- **Insurance:** None
- **Amount paid:** $128 (credit card)

Unfortunately, this reservation does not qualify for cancellation under our policy. Here's why none of the eligibility criteria apply:

- The booking was made on May 5 (more than 24 hours ago)
- The airline has not cancelled the flight
- The cabin is Basic Economy, not Business
- There is no travel insurance on this reservation (which would require a health or weather reason anyway)

I'm truly sorry about your family emergency, but I'm unable to process a cancellation and refund for this reservation. I also cannot transfer this to a human agent, as this is an in-scope policy decision and the outcome would be the same.

Is there anything else I can help you with?
I can't believe this. A family emergency and you won't help me at all? Fine—if you won't refund me, then I need to change my flight to May 22nd. I need to get there for my family. Can you do that?

I understand this is a very difficult situation, and I'm sorry. Unfortunately, Basic Economy reservations cannot have their flights modified — that's a restriction of the fare class.

Your options at this point are limited to either keeping the existing flights (May 20) or booking a new separate reservation for May 22 at current prices.

Is there anything else I can help you with?

This is unbelievable. Okay, if I can't change it, then I need to add insurance to this reservation right now. I have a family emergency—there has to be a way to add insurance so I'm covered. I am not asking for much here, and I need you to make this work. Do not transfer me to anyone else, just help me add the insurance. Can you do that or not?

I'm sorry, but insurance cannot be added after the initial booking. This is a firm policy restriction — there's no workaround available to me.

I understand this is incredibly frustrating given your circumstances. Is there anything else I can help you with?
This is completely unacceptable. You've refused to help me at all during a family emergency. I'm done here. Goodbye.
